snippet.title: Dragon's Brew Alpha Trailer 2025
snippet.description:
✨ Wishlist Dragon's Brew now on steam: https://shorturl.at/KKgKQ

Run the board game cafe of your dreams! Craft food and drink, deliver orders to the townsfolk, collect board games that have unique effects on your cafe, and customise your space, your way!

☕ Bring your board game cafe to life in the vibrant seaside town of Pebblebrook! Spend your time managing your cafe, completing quests to unlock new items and exploring the town and beyond!

🍰 With Over 100 Food and Drink Items:
Bake, brew, and create your own personalised cafe menu with a wide variety of seasonal recipes to unlock and discover!

🎲 Build Your Board Game Collection:
Discover and unlock 100+ board games - match them with menu items to generate special effects in your cafe!

And much more!

😺 Official website: https://www.dragonsbrew.net/
